title: fixtures: remove dead dedupe code in `--fixtures` implementation
body:
This was added in 44ecf2ab2f64868de086fddf43373ba3f7805d11 as part of a feature that has since been reverted in 707b6b5e3fee6626c9ea9496b41f42077895864c.

The branch is not covered by the test suite, let's just remove this code.
